frozen_machine.clause_build_rule: same R21 left-fold OR over each frozen clause then left-fold AND into root
frozen_machine.gc_rule: same R21 reachability GC after every completed clause conjunction

order_normalization: Every order must contain every variable appearing in the frozen frame exactly once. Any structural source order is deduplicated in first-occurrence order and then any missing frame variables are appended in ascending numeric order before any stated reversal/partition transformation.

frozen_order_family.rule: Exact R21 frozen_variable_order: all internal variables in r18.elimination_order(frame,bridge), then bridge variables in direct.occurrence_order(frame), missing bridge variables ascending.
direct.occurrence_order(frame) over all frame variables, normalized by the frozen normalization rule.
Reverse the complete normalized GLOBAL_OCCURRENCE order.
Bridge variables first in normalized GLOBAL_OCCURRENCE relative order, then internal variables in r18.elimination_order(frame,bridge).
Sort all frame variables by descending literal-occurrence count in the frozen frame, tie by ascending variable id.
Sort all frame variables by ascending literal-occurrence count in the frozen frame, tie by ascending variable id.
All frame variables in ascending numeric id.
All frame variables in descending numeric id.

survivor_definition: An order is a BUILD_SURVIVOR iff all 287 frozen clauses are compiled under the exact R21 ROBDD/build/GC semantics within the frozen per-order resource envelope. No semantic claim follows.
resource_only_ranking: Among BUILD_SURVIVOR orders rank by maximum_nodes_seen, then nodes_created_total, then apply_calls_total, then final_active_nodes, then order id. This ranking is structural-resource-only and has no semantic authority.
promotion_rule: R22 never runs semantic truth. If a build survivor exists, a new later gate must freeze one resource-selected order and the full ROBDD candidate before existential quantification and semantic verification. R22 itself authorizes no semantic PASS and no unseen claim.
claim_ceiling: Finite exposed-world build-phase order sensitivity only. It cannot establish an optimal order, polynomial ROBDD size, arbitrary-CNF totality, SAT-in-P, P=NP, or P!=NP.
